title: RAG foundations
subtitle: Build the mental model before choosing infrastructure.
goal: Ask questions about a company's changing rules
intro: A model cannot look inside your company documents unless your application gives it a way to find and read them.
flow: Can I return a sale item?
Sale items: exchange within 14 days, no refunds
Explain the rule and cite sale:r3
case: A shop assistant answers questions using approved return rules.
The rule changes without retraining the language model.
An old or irrelevant paragraph can still produce a wrong answer.
